exposure: Laboratory Risk Indicator for Necrotizing Fasciitis score (using white blood cell count, hemoglobin, sodium, glucose, serum creatinine, and C-reactive protein)
outcome: necrotizing fasciitis involving uterus and abdominal wall
cohort: A 25-year-old white female who developed necrotizing fasciitis after undergoing a cesarean section.
finding: This case describes a rare instance of necrotizing fasciitis post-cesarean section that involved the uterus and abdominal wall, requiring total abdominal hysterectomy and extensive surgical management.
mod_finding: Necrotizing fasciitis developed following a cesarean section, directly linking the mode of birth to the severe infection and subsequent complications including hysterectomy.
